sections.watch_out: Changing the attribute setting here changes how the theme is applied to the page.

summary: Wraps the web app in a theme provider so it can switch between light and dark modes.
purpose: Lets the app remember and apply the user's chosen theme, and lets other components read it.
why: Uses a standard library for themes, so the switching logic does not need to be written by hand.
how: Takes the settings and children it is given and passes them to the theme library's provider unchanged.
inputs: Theme settings and the child components.
outputs: The children wrapped with theme support.
risks: Low risk. Wrong settings passed from the root layout would change theme behavior.
debug: If the theme does not change, check the settings passed from the root layout and the dark mode class setting in the Tailwind config.
